title: 第19章 二级巫师之威第20章 学院的规矩
slug: 巫师让你学知识你杀穿万界
lines: 突然，
天空变了！
伊森瞳孔骤然收缩。
头顶上方约莫数百米处，那片原本澄澈的蓝天，陡然出现了一道漆黑的裂痕。
那裂痕如同被无形的利刃划开，边缘呈现出不规则的锯齿状，内部是纯粹的黑暗，看不见任何东西。
裂痕出现的瞬间，广场上的人群骚动起来。
“那是什么？”
“天空裂了！”
“有东西要出来！”
惊呼声此起彼伏，有人下意识往后退，有人则瞪大眼睛盯着那道裂缝，脸上带着难以置信的惊骇。
伊森目光扫向广场边缘那些灵骨守卫。
那些骷髅依旧静静地立在原地，幽绿的魂火平静地燃烧，没有任何动作，没有任何反应。
“不是袭击。”伊森心中一定，收回目光，重新望向天空。
那道裂缝正在扩大。
从裂缝深处，传来一阵沉闷的撕咬声。
紧接着，一个巨大的狗头从裂缝中探了出来。
那狗头通体漆黑，毛发如钢针般根根竖立，一双眼睛呈现出诡异的猩红色。它的体型庞大得惊人，仅仅是探出的头颅，就有至少十米见方。
它张开嘴，露出满口森白的獠牙，咬住裂缝边缘，用力撕扯。
裂缝以肉眼可见的速度扩大。
狗头的双爪也从裂缝中探出，同样巨大得惊人，爪尖泛着冰冷的寒光。
它双爪扒住裂缝两侧，用力向外掰扯，整个身体都在用力，肌肉在皮毛下剧烈起伏。
广场上鸦雀无声。
所有人都被这一幕震撼得说不出话来。
有的新生双腿发软，直接坐倒在地。
有的脸色煞白，嘴唇剧烈颤抖。有的则瞪大眼睛，死死盯着那个巨大的狗头，眼中闪过恐惧、敬畏、还有一丝难以言喻的狂热。
伊森站在原地，目光死死盯着那个正在撕扯空间的巨犬。
他能感觉到那股从裂缝中弥漫出来的气息。
恐怖。
碾压性的恐怖。
仅仅是逸散出来的些许波动，就让他浑身汗毛倒竖，本能地想要逃离。
但他没有动。
大概一分钟左右。
那巨犬终于将裂缝撕扯出足够大的空间。
content_en:
suddenly,
The sky has changed!
Ethan's pupils suddenly shrank.
About a few hundred meters above the head, a dark crack suddenly appeared in the originally clear blue sky.
The crack seemed to be cut open by an invisible sharp blade, and the edges showed irregular jagged shapes. The interior was pure darkness, and nothing could be seen.
The moment the crack appeared, the crowd in the square became commotion.
"What's that?"
"The sky cracked!"
"Something's coming out!"
Exclamations came one after another. Some people subconsciously stepped back, while others stared at the crack with wide eyes, unbelievable horror on their faces.
Ethan glanced at the spirit bone guards at the edge of the square.
Those skeletons still stood quietly in place, the green soul fire burning calmly, without any movement or reaction.
"It's not an attack." Ethan confirmed in his mind, retracting his gaze and looking at the sky again.
That crack is widening.
From the depths of the crack, there was a dull sound of biting.
Then, a huge dog head poked out of the crack.
The dog's head was completely black, its hair stood on end like steel needles, and its eyes were a strange scarlet color. Its size was astonishingly huge, with just its head protruding out, it was at least ten meters square.
It opened its mouth, revealing its white fangs, biting the edge of the crack and tearing hard.
The cracks expand at a rate visible to the naked eye.
The two claws of the dog's head also poked out from the crack. They were also astonishingly huge, and the tips of the claws glowed with an icy cold light.
It grabbed both sides of the crack with its claws and pulled outwards with force. The whole body was exerting force, and the muscles undulated violently under the fur.
There was silence in the square.
Everyone was shocked speechless by this scene.
Some freshmen's legs became weak and they sat down directly on the ground.
Some turned pale and their lips trembled violently. Some stared wide-eyed at the huge dog head, with fear, awe, and a hint of unspeakable fanaticism flashing in their eyes.
Ethan stood there, staring intently at the giant dog that was tearing apart the space.
He could feel the breath coming from the cracks.
fear.
Crushing terror.
Just a few fluctuations that escaped made the hair on his body stand on end, and he instinctively wanted to escape.
But he didn't move.
About a minute or so.
The giant dog finally tore out enough space in the crack.
